name: hero-carousel
title: Hero Carousel
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A full-bleed photo hero with a queue of cards: the front card is the slide on screen, the ones behind it are what comes next. Every five seconds or on a click the queue slides forward, the photograph behind crossfades and the headline and caption follow. A glass panel carries the faces of past guests, an intro and the call to action.
docs: Named export: HeroCarousel. Composed from the avatar-stack item, which installs alongside it. Pass `slides` ({ image, alt, title, description?, heading?, position? }), `eyebrow`, `heading`, `intro`, `avatars` + `avatarsLabel`, `cta` ({ label, href }) and `linkComponent`. `interval` is the autoplay gap in ms (0 turns it off), `accent` sets --primary, `reveal` is in-view or immediate, `onChange` reports the front slide.
